label: Electronic public procurement system outdated and in need of replacement
definition: The electronic public procurement system is outdated or functionally inadequate: it does not support all procedures, tools or stages of the procurement cycle set out in law, hampers centralised procurement, and has to be re-engineered or replaced by a new system.
exclusion_notes: A working system whose modules are incomplete or little used belongs to RI-TEC-006. Procurement reform without a digital element is outside the theme.
notes: From CI-01 (20 items, recommendations from 2021 to 2026). Added beside RI-TEC-006 rather than widening it, because RI-TEC-006 is cited by the closed run (S4).

label: Domestic preconditions for the European Health Insurance Card not in place
definition: The country has no national health insurance card or integrated health information system, so it cannot yet issue or accept the European Health Insurance Card at accession.
exclusion_notes: Access to healthcare through bilateral arrangements belongs to RI-FMW-011; electronic exchange of social security data (EESSI) belongs to RI-FMW-010.
notes: From CI-02 (12 items). Chapter 2 issue; items keep their own theme tags.

label: Public sector websites and apps not accessible to persons with disabilities
definition: Public sector websites, mobile applications and other digital public services are not accessible to persons with physical, sensory or intellectual disabilities, and the EU accessibility requirements for them (the Web Accessibility Directive and the European Accessibility Act) are not applied or enforced.
exclusion_notes: Accessibility of audiovisual media services, buildings and transport is outside the theme. The range and use of e-services belong to RI-TEC-036 and RI-TEC-037.
notes: From CI-06 (4 items, a 2026 key recommendation under Chapter 10). G5-D05 of RUN-2026-01 rejected a similar issue only because no EU source raised it; does not reopen that decision for North Macedonia.

label: Semiconductor acquis not aligned
definition: Legislation is not aligned with the EU acquis on semiconductors, in particular the Chips Act.
exclusion_notes: Protection of topographies of semiconductor products as intellectual property belongs to Chapter 7, outside the theme, except as context for alignment.
notes: Only if G4-D07 brings semiconductors into the theme. One key recommendation (2026) and two findings (2025, 2026).
